# CoForge Design System

> Agent-readable index. 787 design tokens (W3C DTCG), 8 level-1 primitives, 0 full components. Load this once; fetch detail on demand.

## Rules

- Every colour, spacing, radius and type value comes from `design-system/tokens/tokens.json`. No raw hex, no raw px. Enforced by a PreToolUse hook, not by convention.
- No component may be used that is not in `design-system/component-index.json`.
- L1 output may use **level-1 entries only**; L2 output may use the full index (ADR-012).
- To propose something new, write a `component-spec` artifact and request promotion. Promotion is the only path in.

## Level 1 primitives — usable in Foundations output

- [badge](design-system/component-index.json): A small label carrying status or count.
- [card](design-system/component-index.json): A bounded surface grouping related content.
- [chart-palette](design-system/component-index.json): The ordered categorical palette for data visualisation.
- [colour-roles](design-system/component-index.json): Semantic colour roles — background, layer, text, border, support.
- [rule](design-system/component-index.json): A horizontal or vertical divider.
- [spacing-scale](design-system/component-index.json): The spacing steps. All margin, padding and gap come from here.
- [table](design-system/component-index.json): Tabular data with header, rows and optional zebra striping.
- [type-scale](design-system/component-index.json): Heading and body sizes. The only legal type sizes for L1 output.
